personal_military_connection: Not stated in his own words on pages checked. JLD Realty Group is described on the site as 'a veteran-owned, family-operated team rooted in Navarre, Florida' (https://jldrealtygroup.com/about) — a company-level claim, not a first-person statement from John. Separately, client testimonials published on his own testimonials page say "John's background as a veteran and Military Relocation Professional" and "John is a veteran" (https://jldrealtygroup.com/details/706/Military_Testimonials) — these are client quotes he has chosen to publish, not his own statement, so this field is being reported with that distinction rather than treated as a personal claim.
military_content_depth_note: Site has a dedicated 'What is an MRP?' page, a separate 'Military Testimonials' page, and a 'VA Loans' page covering benefits like 'No Down Payment' and 'No Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI)' and mortgage myths — but no BAH figures, no named bases, and no on-base/off-base or school-zone content were found, so it falls short of 'detailed guide.'
notes: Zillow returned HTTP 429 on every attempt (5 retries across the session) for https://www.zillow.com/profile/John%20Delbert — per instructions I did not substitute another source, so all zillow_* fields are null and unconfirmed, not zero. A search snippet titled 'John Delbert - Real Estate Agent in Destin, FL - Reviews' suggests this is likely the right profile (Destin is adjacent to his Navarre practice area) but this was never verified against brokerage/team name since the page never rendered. License number was not found on any JLD Realty Group page checked (only the brokerage's business licenses BK3401960 and CQ1072990 were listed, not John's individual salesperson license). The MRP claim is made about the designation generically on a company page rather than as an explicit first-person 'I am MRP-certified' statement by John himself — flagged as a softer form of the claim than Amelia Garrett's.
